headline: Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed says most government officials are thieves
summary: The Speaker of the National Parliament has made a startling claim about the integrity of the country's civil servants.
details: Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed has stated that a majority of government officials in Bangladesh are thieves.
The remarks were made during a public gathering, where he described the current state of the country as 'strange'.
The Speaker's blunt assessment highlights deep-seated concerns regarding corruption within the administrative machinery of the state.
This statement from a high-ranking official of the state's legislative body is seen as a significant admission of systemic corruption.

headline: 7 life imprisonment for 7 in garments officer murder in Narayanganj
summary: A court has sentenced seven people to life imprisonment for the killing of garments officer Sakhawat Hossain Shuvro in 2017.
details: A Narayanganj court has sentenced seven people to life imprisonment for the brutal murder of garments officer Sakhawat Hossain Shuvro.
The verdict was delivered by Narayanganj District and Sessions Judge Md. Abu Shamim Azad on Sunday afternoon.
According to the Public Prosecutor, the victim was lured to an under-construction building in the Masdair area of Fatullah on August 15, 2017.
The attackers used sharp weapons to repeatedly strike the victim's head, killing him before throwing his body from the building to cover up the crime.
Following the murder, the victim's father filed a murder case with the Fatullah Police Station naming seven specific suspects.
The court reached the verdict after hearing 29 witnesses and reviewing the arguments presented during the long trial.
caption:
Seven people have been sentenced to life imprisonment for the 2017 murder of a garments officer in Narayanganj.

A Narayanganj court has sentenced seven people to life imprisonment for the brutal murder of garments officer Sakhawat Hossain Shuvro.

The verdict was delivered by Narayanganj District and Sessions Judge Md. Abu Shamim Azad on Sunday afternoon.

According to the Public Prosecutor, the victim was lured to an under-construction building in the Masdair area of Fatullah on August 15, 2017.

The attackers used sharp weapons to repeatedly strike the victim's head, killing him before throwing his body from the building to cover up the crime.

Following the murder, the victim's father filed a murder case with the Fatullah Police Station naming seven specific suspects.

The court reached the verdict after hearing 29 witnesses and reviewing the arguments presented during the long trial.
